meta.text: [fx:stream] <nonce> How are you doing today, my friend?
meta.debounce: The text ends in "?", so both apps use the 400 ms sentence-final debounce; it is inside every translation timing.
meta.compression: Local servers send everything uncompressed (one policy for every app); compare the computed gzip sizes.
meta.network: Throttled profiles (iphone-webkit-slow4g, pixel-chromium-4xcpu-slow4g) go through e2e/perf/throttle-proxy.ts: one shared link, RTT per request, +1 RTT per new connection (per connection, never delaying others), shared down/up bandwidth, for both engines. Every non-loopback request (CDN fonts, analytics) is sent to a closed proxy port and fails, and e2e/perf/gateway.ts answers every font request with 404, for every app.
notes: TTFB/FCP/LCP/DOMContentLoaded/load are ms from navigation start (Navigation and Paint Timing, PerformanceObserver).

Done = Copy enabled, main text present, no fetch/XHR/EventSource started after the last keystroke still in flight (Playwright request events) and at least one finished, and no DOM change outside <head> for 500 ms after the latest of Copy, last DOM change and last request end; done = that latest time (no Listen button needed). streamEndMinusLastDom shows a response held open after the last visible change.
Input kept from = max(FCP, earliest kept keystroke) from the space probe; whether input is acted on is the burst gate.

First typeable = max(FCP, earliest kept keystroke, earliest acted-on keystroke) for one sentence typed as a burst at the first moment the textarea takes focus; a dropped burst is cleared and retyped after the page settles (network idle + 500 ms) and that penalty is included.
TBT = sum over long tasks of the part after FCP beyond 50 ms, until 1 s after network idle (Chromium only: WebKit has no longtask entries).
LCP and CLS need largest-contentful-paint / layout-shift entries; supportedEntryTypes per profile says which engine has them.
"First main char" is the DOM mutation that first shows main text (MutationObserver, performance.now()), not a paint.
JS total = external script bodies + executable inline <script> of the document; gzip = gzip -9 of decoded bodies.
Keyboard dy is not "lower is better": read it together with the visibility flags.
Every load starts in a fresh browser context (empty cache, no cookies, service workers blocked); repeat = second navigation in the same context.

server.note: Local process restarted per sample; cold = first GET / after TCP readiness, warm = the second GET. Node client, new connection each.
